card.name: Linking words in drug interaction sentences
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as when, after, are, is, used just before a phrase about taking drugs together or stopping a drug. Seen in drug interaction and dose adjustment sentences.

modes.label: When used together
modes.description: The word when or used right after a drug name, leading into concomitant use.
modes.example: The following drugs<< when>> used concomitantly with ZYP

modes.label: Verb before co-administration
modes.description: A form of be after a drug name, before prescribed or co-administered with another drug.
modes.example: When nifedipine<< is>> co-administered with tac

modes.label: After stopping
modes.description: The word after following a condition, leading into discontinuation.
modes.example: Severe acute exacerbations of hepatitis B virus infection<< after>> discontinuation: Monitor hepatic function closely

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words just before the text says what happens when two drugs are taken together.
